values.note: Chippewa County: every site $20 a night; electricity (20/30/50 A, optional) $7 more; a site with its own boat dock $5 more. $7 reservation fee per reservation; the seventh night of one reservation is free. Dump station elsewhere $2 for campers.

values.note: Reservations open the first working day of the year at 8 am and cover May to mid-September; they must be made at least 10 days ahead and run 3-14 nights. Unreserved sites are sold by the caretaker first come, first served for the night, and from mid-September through October all camping is self-registration. Check-in and check-out 1 pm.

note: Chippewa County campground in the county forest at the north end of Otter Lake, beside a separate day park with a beach, boat launch and picnic shelters. Fifteen sites have their own boat dock. Little to no cell service; an emergency phone is at the entrance. --Claude
summary: Chippewa County campground page, Terms & Conditions (4-9-25), site search (June 2027), map and imagery read: $20 + $7 optional electric + $5 dock, $7 reservation fee; reservations 10+ days ahead with a 3-night minimum / 14 max, unreserved sites first come; May-Oct; 22 sites, all 20/30/50 A; flush toilets, showers, fill station, no dump. Lakefront -> lakeview (canopy to the shore). Pin ~520 m off in the lake.
